main_text.l: tidie eduntur in Gallia, Germania,
Anglia, aliisque regionibus haeresi infectis.
Quis sufficeret omnibus recensendis &
censura notandis? quos sane ut dicitur,
ναῦς μὴ μία πάντας ἀγ[?], deinde hac
censurā Capello magnum & optatum
beneficium conferetur,nam haeretici de-
cem & amplius annis, diligenter
cave-runt, ne liber iste ederetur; diu Genevae
Manuscriptus haesit,sed ut imprimeretur,

gduni Batavorum: sed repulsam quam
Genevae passus erat,illis quoq; locis, licet
Lugduni editionem Salmasius urgeret,
passus est; sentiebant scilicet Ministri va-
lidissimum argumentum ac pene unicū,
quo hacten9 in vulgatam usi fuerant, va-
lidissime subduci,hoc nempe, Texus He-
braeus est plane incorruptus,qualis à Mo-se
& Prophetis est Spiritu S. dictante fu-s-
us; ergo translatio omnis huic primi-
genio textui non consentiens ad hunc

vul-gata innumeris locis ab Hebraeo Textu

page.notes: Right edge: fragments of the neighbouring page, not printed text on this page. Greek word at the end of the first line is uncertain: final letters read as "ἀγ" with a doubtful last character. Word "fusus" at the line break ("fu-sus") is read with the first letter as long s; the printed letters are unclear. Some words are printed with long s ("s"), transcribed as plain s. The line "ergo innumeris locis castiganda est," ends the printed paragraph at the bottom of the page; the paragraph continues beyond the page.
